body.message:
Hi, I just wanted to let you know that I’m currently in India, and I’m looking for accommodation around 12 October.

Initially, I need the accommodation for one month, but if everything goes well, I may extend my stay further.

I have a few important requirements: I need access to a kitchen, a private room with an attached bathroom, and preferably everything included in the rent.

Could you please clarify all the details for me, including:
• Exact location of the property
• Type of accommodation and room
• Kitchen facilities and whether cooking is allowed
• Attached/private bathroom
• What is included in the rent (electricity, water, gas, Wi-Fi, etc.)
• Any security deposit, commission, or other charges
• Whether there are any hidden or additional charges
• How many people are staying in the apartment and how many rooms it has

Please explain everything clearly once, including the total amount I would need to pay, so there are no surprises later.

Thank you so much for your cooperation. I really appreciate it.
